**Finding: missing (medium severity) — TRANSITION**

The agreement has no exit/transition provision:

- **§13 (p0078)** only confirms Client retains ownership of its domains and Client Content, and puts the burden *on us* to arrange a new name server (30 days) / hosting environment (60 days).
- **§14 (p0079)** just continues services until the last day of the month following our termination notice.
- **§10 (Confidentiality)** contains no return-of-materials or deletion mechanic, and nothing elsewhere addresses data export.

Since TrueLink hosts our Client Content and Credit Data, this fails even the fallback (90 days of assistance plus export within 30 days). I inserted the preferred clause as new §14a immediately after the termination paragraph (which sits within the surviving Sections 5–30): up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of all Client Content/Credit Data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and deletion with written certification thereafter — with the 90-day fallback offered in the negotiation comment. Redline validated (ok:true) and finding submitted.
